note: Six capabilities are the departed product's (the course batch, admin lists, public pages, the catalog word, the database package, the product's contexts) and left with it (D-111). CAP-009 (the context map units/cells, scripts/generate context-map, the intents registry and the L3.context-dag/context-size rules) and CAP-010 (the vendor map scripts/lib/vendor-map.json and the L3.vendor-driver/dependency-declared/vendor-retired rules) were the archived product's tooling (archive 567176bb, D-110) and left with it too (D-111): the site that came back under apps/web (D-319) holds none of them; its own ring check is apps/web/tooling/check-architecture.mjs (CAP-004), and the engine's vendor rule is D-069 item 7 (scripts/lib/vendor_check.py). CAP-004 and CAP-005 are realized by the returned site (units/web), CAP-012 is active: its design merged with KD1 (PR #572) and engine-defects realizes it. CAP-011 (one documented catalog key per value in apps/web) was D-063's, and D-063 retired with Open University: D-111 names OU's literal baselines and catalogs among what left, and the site that came back (D-319) has no literal-catalogs manifest; the engine's literals are D-068's census (LT1), out of CAP-011's scope.
